title: Oven Baked Thai Chicken Bake
description: A cultured and flaky post-workout Thai dish featuring golden syrup, baked to perfection in a lazy-susan-spinner vessel, this central-Thai inspired recipe is nut-free-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together golden syrup, fish sauce, lime juice, and olive oil.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
In a small bowl, mix together garlic and ginger.
Add the garlic and ginger mixture to the bowl with the chicken and toss to combine.
Add the Thai red curry paste to the bowl and toss to coat the chicken.
Transfer the chicken to a lazy-susan-spinner vessel and bake for 25 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and slightly caramelized.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
